shortdesc.ph: The information of the detected human face.

plentry.pd: The x-coordinate (in pixels) of the face in the local video. This value indicates the horizontal position of the top-left corner of the face relative to the top-left origin of the captured frame.
The y-coordinate (in pixels) of the face in the local video. This value indicates the vertical position of the top-left corner of the face relative to the top-left origin of the captured frame.
The width (in pixels) of the face in the captured video frame.
The height (in pixels) of the face in the captured video frame.
The distance (in centimeters) between the face and the device screen.

pd.p: The x-coordinate (px) of the human face in the local video. The horizontal position relative to the origin, where the upper left corner of the captured video is the origin, and the x-coordinate is the upper left corner of the watermark.

The y-coordinate (px) of the human face in the local video. Taking the top left corner of the captured video as the origin, the y coordinate represents the relative longitudinal displacement of the top left corner of the human face to the origin.
The width (px) of the human face in the captured video.
The height (px) of the human face in the captured video.
The distance between the human face and the device screen (cm).
